3.104
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I invoke the god Brahmā, Parameṣṭhin, / the cause of the creation, preservation, and dissolution of this universe,
who possesses the four Vedas, four-faced, the sovereign ruler of the four classes, / the protector of the four stages of life, the boon-giver, source of all beings,
lotus-born, the source of the universe, the source of sacrifice, the lord of the universe, / self-born, unassailable, the conveyor of sacrifice, the lord of the universe,
lord of the sacrifice and having the form of sacrifice, the sole cause of the three worlds, / all-pervading, giver of joy, gentle, supreme, the highest lord,
lord of past, future, and present, known through yoga, eternal. / Come, blessed Brahmā, for the prosperity of the patron of the sacrifice!
Here is water for hospitality, here is water for the feet, and let this incense be accepted! / I invoke the god, the God of gods, Fire,

the maker of the creation, preservation, and dissolution of this universe, / the form of the gods, their support, the mouth of all gods, the lord,
having reddish-brown eyes and reddish-brown matted locks, whose banner is smoke, possessor of radiant light, / the god who moves in a chariot drawn by parrots, adorned with all ornaments,

snigdhavaidūryasaṅkāśaṃ varuṇaṃ sumahādyutim ..
ehi deva jalādhyakṣa yādogaṇamaheśvara .. 25 ..
nāgadaityoragagaṇaiḥ satataṃ sevitācyuta ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ candraṃ śītāṃśumamṛtaprabham .. 26 ..
oṣadhīśaṃ dvijādhyakṣaṃ nayanānandakārakama ..
ehi me bhagavañcandra śaśāṅka mṛgalāñchana .. 27 ..
bhaktānukampinsatataṃ sarvanakṣatrapūjita ..
bhaumamāvāhayiṣyāmi tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam .. 28 ..
bhadramūrtimanirdeśyaṃ vaktraṃ rudhirasaprabham ..
ehi me bhagavanbhauma aṅgārakasamaprabha .. 29 ..
3.21.d:
एहि मे रत्नबहुले बहुरूपे महाबले॥
आवाहयिष्ये वरदं सहस्रांशुं दिवाकरम् ॥
तेजोमूर्तिं दुराधर्षं भक्तानामभयप्रदम्॥
एहि देव जगन्नाथ ऋक्सामयजुषां पते ॥23॥
त्रैलोक्यमण्डले दीप सर्वव्याधिविनाशन ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवमादित्यमुदकेशयम् ॥ 24 ॥
स्निग्धवैदूर्यसङ्काशं वरुणं सुमहाद्युतिम् ॥
एहि देव जलाध्यक्ष यादोगणमहेश्वर ॥ 25 ॥
नागदैत्योरगगणैः सततं सेविताच्युत ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं चन्द्रं शीतांशुममृतप्रभम् ॥ 26 ॥
ओषधीशं द्विजाध्यक्षं नयनानन्दकारकम ॥
एहि मे भगवञ्चन्द्र शशाङ्क मृगलाञ्छन ॥ 27 ॥
भक्तानुकम्पिन्सततं सर्वनक्षत्रपूजित ॥
भौममावाहयिष्यामि तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदम् ॥ 28 ॥
भद्रमूर्तिमनिर्देश्यं वक्त्रं रुधिरसप्रभम् ॥
एहि मे भगवन्भौम अङ्गारकसमप्रभ ॥ 29 ॥
3.21.m:
Come to me, full of jewels, multiform, of great strength! / I will invoke the boon-giver, the thousand-rayed Sun, / having a body of light, difficult to assault, bestower of fearlessness on devotees. / Come, O god, Lord of the Universe, master of the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajur Vedas,
lamp in the sphere of the three worlds, destroyer of all diseases! / I invoke the god, the Āditya who rests in water,
resembling glossy lapis lazuli, Varuṇa of very great splendour. / Come, O god, superintendent of the waters, supreme lord of the host of aquatic creatures,
infallible one constantly served by hosts of Nāgas, Daityas, and serpents! / I invoke the moon, cool-rayed, having the splendour of nectar,
lord of plants, sovereign of the twice-born, delighting the eyes. / Come to me, blessed Moon, Śaśāṅka, hare-marked one,
compassionate to devotees always, worshipped by all the lunar mansions! / I will invoke Mars, having a body of light, hard to approach.
Whose form is auspicious, indescribable, whose face shines like blood: / come to me, Lord Bhauma, glowing like glowing charcoal!

3.21.s:
tvayi sarvaṃ samāyattaṃ bhūtale'smiñśubhāśubham ..
skandamāvāhayiṣyāmi ṣaṇmukhaṃ varadaṃ śiśum .. 3.104.30 ..
devārisenāmathanaṃ pārvatyānandavardhanama ..
ehi deva kumārādya mahiṣāsurataskara .. 31 ..
kārtikeya jagannātha mayūravaravāhana ..
budhamāvāhayiṣyāmi bodhanaṃ jagadīśvaram .. 32 ..
cāndriṃ grahagaṇādhyakṣaṃ tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam ..
ehi śītāṃśujācintya jagajjiṣṇo janārdana .. 33 ..
mahābala mahābhāga mahābāho mahādyute ..
viṣṇumāvāhayiṣyāmi śaṅkhacakragadādharam .. 34 ..
atasīkusumaśyāmaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam ..
ehi me devadeveśa prajānirmāṇakāraka .. 35 ..
nārāyaṇa suduṣpāra maheṣvāsa dhanurdhara ..
śakramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ suragaṇeśvaram .. 36 ..
vajrapāṇiṃ mahābāhuṃ gobrāhmaṇahite ratam ..
ehi deva sahasrākṣa devāribalasūdana .. 37..
3.21.d:
त्वयि सर्वं समायत्तं भूतलेऽस्मिञ्शुभाशुभम् ॥
स्कन्दमावाहयिष्यामि षण्मुखं वरदं शिशुम् ॥ 3.104.30 ॥
देवारिसेनामथनं पार्वत्यानन्दवर्धनम ॥
एहि देव कुमाराद्य महिषासुरतस्कर ॥ 31 ॥
कार्तिकेय जगन्नाथ मयूरवरवाहन ॥
बुधमावाहयिष्यामि बोधनं जगदीश्वरम् ॥ 32 ॥
चान्द्रिं ग्रहगणाध्यक्षं तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदम् ॥
एहि शीतांशुजाचिन्त्य जगज्जिष्णो जनार्दन ॥ 33 ॥
महाबल महाभाग महाबाहो महाद्युते ॥
विष्णुमावाहयिष्यामि शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् ॥ 34 ॥
अतसीकुसुमश्यामं पीतवाससमच्युतम् ॥
एहि मे देवदेवेश प्रजानिर्माणकारक ॥ 35 ॥
नारायण सुदुष्पार महेष्वास धनुर्धर ॥
शक्रमावाहयिष्यामि देवं सुरगणेश्वरम् ॥ 36 ॥
वज्रपाणिं महाबाहुं गोब्राह्मणहिते रतम् ॥
एहि देव सहस्राक्ष देवारिबलसूदन ॥ 37॥
3.21.m:
On you all good and evil on this earth depends. / I shall invoke Skanda, six-faced, granter of boons, the youth,
Crusher of the army of the gods' enemies, increaser of Pārvatī's joy: / come, god, Kumāra, foremost one, captor of Mahiṣāsura,
Kārtikeya, lord of the world, whose excellent mount is the peacock! / I shall invoke Budha, the awakener, lord of the universe,
Son of the Moon, chief of the planetary hosts, embodiment of radiance, difficult to approach: / come, son of the cool-rayed Moon, inconceivable one, conqueror of the world, Janārdana,
Mighty one, illustrious one, long-armed one of great splendour! / I shall invoke Viṣṇu, holder of conch, discus, and mace,
Dark as an atasī flower, yellow-robed, infallible: / come to me, god of gods, creator of creatures,
Nārāyaṇa, hard to cross, great archer, bearer of the bow! / I shall invoke Śakra, the god, sovereign of the divine hosts,
Vajra-handed, mighty-armed, devoted to the welfare of cows and brahmins: / come, god, thousand-eyed one, slayer of the armies of the gods' enemies,

3.21.s:
airāvataga dharmajña śacīhṛdayanandana ..
jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deveśvarapurohitam .. 38 ..
bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhadvākyaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam ..
ehi jīva mahābhāga jīvabhūta mahītale..39..
samyagvṛddhistavāyattā satataṃ bhūmivardhana ..
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi pārvatīṃ varadāmumām ..3.104.40..
harasya dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ cārvaṅgīṃ bhūtivardhinīm ..
ehi devi jaganmātarmenāhṛdayanandini..41..
pavitre varade saumye nityaṃ bhaktajanapriye..
śukramāvāhayiṣyāmi bhārgavaṃ jagadīśvaram..42..
nityaṃ sarvadhanādhyakṣaṃ tapasā dyotitaprabhama ..
ehi śukra mahābhāga ṣoḍaśārce varaprada..43..
prabhustvaṃ varado nityaṃ varṣāvarṣasya nigrahe..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ prajādhyakṣamakalmaṣam .. 44 ..
bhaktānukaṃpinaṃ devaṃ prajānirmāṇakārakam ..
ehi deva prajādhyakṣa prajānirmāṇakāraka ..45..
3.21.d:
ऐरावतग धर्मज्ञ शचीहृदयनन्दन ॥
जीवमावाहयिष्यामि देवेश्वरपुरोहितम् ॥ 38 ॥
बृहस्पतिं बृहद्वाक्यं वेदवेदांगपारगम् ॥
एहि जीव महाभाग जीवभूत महीतले॥39॥
सम्यग्वृद्धिस्तवायत्ता सततं भूमिवर्धन ॥
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि पार्वतीं वरदामुमाम् ॥3.104.40॥
हरस्य दयितां भार्यां चार्वङ्गीं भूतिवर्धिनीम् ॥
एहि देवि जगन्मातर्मेनाहृदयनन्दिनि॥41॥
पवित्रे वरदे सौम्ये नित्यं भक्तजनप्रिये॥
शुक्रमावाहयिष्यामि भार्गवं जगदीश्वरम्॥42॥
नित्यं सर्वधनाध्यक्षं तपसा द्योतितप्रभम ॥
एहि शुक्र महाभाग षोडशार्चे वरप्रद॥43॥
प्रभुस्त्वं वरदो नित्यं वर्षावर्षस्य निग्रहे॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं प्रजाध्यक्षमकल्मषम् ॥ 44 ॥
भक्तानुकंपिनं देवं प्रजानिर्माणकारकम् ॥
एहि देव प्रजाध्यक्ष प्रजानिर्माणकारक ॥45॥
3.21.m:
Rider of Airāvata, knower of dharma, delight of Śacī's heart! / I shall invoke Jīva, chaplain of the lord of the gods,
Bṛhaspati, of vast speech, who has crossed to the farther shore of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas: / come, Jīva, illustrious one, the very soul of life on earth!
All proper growth depends on you, perpetual nourisher of the earth! / I shall invoke the goddess, Pārvatī, Umā who grants boons,
Beloved wife of Hara, of lovely limbs, increaser of prosperity: / come, goddess, mother of the universe, delight of Menā's heart,
Pure, boon-granting, gentle, always dear to devotees! / I shall invoke Śukra, the descendant of Bhṛgu, lord of the universe,
Ever presiding over all wealth, whose brilliance shines through ascetic heat: / come, Śukra, illustrious one, sixteen-rayed, granter of boons!
You are the lord, ever granting boons in withholding rain and drought. / I invoke the spotless god, lord of creatures,
Compassionate to devotees, the god who brings forth creatures: / come, god, lord of creatures, creator of creatures!

3.21.s:
tvayi deva samāyattaṃ prajānāmabhavodbhavam ..
saurimāvāhayiṣyāmi śanaiścāriṇamacyutam .. 46 ..
tapasvinamanādhṛṣyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam ..
ehi tīkṣṇāṃśujācintya bhāvābhāvapradarśaka ..47..
tvayi sarvaṃ mamāyattaṃ rājñāṃ bhūmau śubhāśubham ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ gajavaktraṃ gaṇeśvaram ..48..
vighneśaṃ vighnahartāraṃ pārvatī hṛdayapriyam ..
ehi deva gaṇādhyakṣa lambodara mahābhuja .. 49 ..
kāryasiddhiḥ samāyattā tvayi sarveśa dehinām..
rāhumāvāhayiṣyāmi daityeṃdraṃ grahatāṃ gatam ..3.104.50..
keśavāptavaraṃ vīraṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam ..
ehyehi daityapravara varadācintyavikrama .. 51 ..
tamomūrte durādharṣaṃ viparītāmbarāmbara ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ viśvakarmāṇamacyutam .. 52 ..
sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu sadā śilpapravartakam ..
ehi devavarācintya sarvaśilpapravartaka .. 53 ..
3.21.d:
त्वयि देव समायत्तं प्रजानामभवोद्भवम् ॥
सौरिमावाहयिष्यामि शनैश्चारिणमच्युतम् ॥ 46 ॥
तपस्विनमनाधृष्यं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् ॥
एहि तीक्ष्णांशुजाचिन्त्य भावाभावप्रदर्शक ॥47॥
त्वयि सर्वं ममायत्तं राज्ञां भूमौ शुभाशुभम् ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं गजवक्त्रं गणेश्वरम् ॥48॥
विघ्नेशं विघ्नहर्तारं पार्वती हृदयप्रियम् ॥
एहि देव गणाध्यक्ष लम्बोदर महाभुज ॥ 49 ॥
कार्यसिद्धिः समायत्ता त्वयि सर्वेश देहिनाम्॥
राहुमावाहयिष्यामि दैत्येंद्रं ग्रहतां गतम् ॥3.104.50॥
केशवाप्तवरं वीरं तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषम् ॥
एह्येहि दैत्यप्रवर वरदाचिन्त्यविक्रम ॥ 51 ॥
तमोमूर्ते दुराधर्षं विपरीताम्बराम्बर ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं विश्वकर्माणमच्युतम् ॥ 52 ॥
सर्वासां देवतानां तु सदा शिल्पप्रवर्तकम् ॥
एहि देववराचिन्त्य सर्वशिल्पप्रवर्तक ॥ 53 ॥
3.21.m:
On you, O god, depends the rise and non-existence of creatures. / I shall invoke Sauri, slow-moving, unswerving,
Ascetic, unassailable, who gives fearlessness to devotees: / come, son of the sharp-rayed Sun, inconceivable one, revealer of being and non-being!
On you depends all good and ill of kings on earth. / I invoke the elephant-faced god, lord of the gaṇas,
Lord of obstacles, remover of obstacles, dear to Pārvatī's heart: / come, god, overseer of the gaṇas, pot-bellied, mighty-armed!
Success in undertakings depends on you, lord of all embodied beings! / I shall invoke Rāhu, prince of Daityas who attained the state of a planet,
Who obtained a boon from Keśava, heroic, sins burned away by ascetic heat: / come, come, foremost of Daityas, boon-giver of inconceivable valour,
Embodiment of darkness, hard to withstand, clothed in the inverted sky! / I invoke the imperishable god Viśvakarman,
Who constantly sets in motion the craft of all the deities: / come, inconceivable best of gods, instigator of all crafts!

3.21.s:
ehi devavarācintya sadā śilpapravartaka ..
tvayi sarveśa sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāmāśritā gatiḥ .. 54 ..
ketumāvāhayiṣyāmi ketuṃ sarvadivaukasām ..
brāhmaṇyaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam .. 55 ..
dhūmaketo ihābhyehi hutāśanasamaprabha..
śikhākarālavikaca pūjakārtivināśana..56..
āvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ kṛttikāṃ devapūjitām ..
ehi sādhāraṇe devi jyeṣṭhe dakṣasute śubhe..57..
āvāhayāmi varadāṃ rohiṇīṃ candravallabhām ..
ehi rohiṇi dharmajñe dhruvakarmasu śobhane..58..
āvāhayāmi varadāmilvilāṃ śaśivallabhām ..
ehi me ilvile devi mṛdukarmasu śobhane..59..
rudramāvāhayiṣyāmi trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam ..
ehi śaṅkara sarvātmanmahāgaṇagaṇeśvara ..3.104.60..
ārdrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ bāhusaṃjñitam ..
ehyārdre cārusarvāṅgi dāruṇe rudrasammite ..61 ..
3.21.d:
एहि देववराचिन्त्य सदा शिल्पप्रवर्तक ॥
त्वयि सर्वेश सर्वेषां कर्मणामाश्रिता गतिः ॥ 54 ॥
केतुमावाहयिष्यामि केतुं सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥
ब्राह्मण्यं सर्वधर्मज्ञं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् ॥ 55 ॥
धूमकेतो इहाभ्येहि हुताशनसमप्रभ॥
शिखाकरालविकच पूजकार्तिविनाशन॥56॥
आवाहयिष्यामि शुभां कृत्तिकां देवपूजिताम् ॥
एहि साधारणे देवि ज्येष्ठे दक्षसुते शुभे॥57॥
आवाहयामि वरदां रोहिणीं चन्द्रवल्लभाम् ॥
एहि रोहिणि धर्मज्ञे ध्रुवकर्मसु शोभने॥58॥
आवाहयामि वरदामिल्विलां शशिवल्लभाम् ॥
एहि मे इल्विले देवि मृदुकर्मसु शोभने॥59॥
रुद्रमावाहयिष्यामि त्रिनेत्रं शूलपाणिनम् ॥
एहि शङ्कर सर्वात्मन्महागणगणेश्वर ॥3.104.60॥
आर्द्रामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं बाहुसंज्ञितम् ॥
एह्यार्द्रे चारुसर्वाङ्गि दारुणे रुद्रसम्मिते ॥61 ॥
3.21.m:
Come, inconceivable best of gods, who ever sets crafts in motion: / on you, lord of all, depends the course of all actions!
I shall invoke Ketu, banner of all the celestial beings, / devoted to brahmins, knower of all dharma, granter of fearlessness to devotees:
Dhūmaketu, come hither, equal in radiance to fire, / with fierce, bristling crest, destroyer of the afflictions of your worshippers!
I shall invoke the auspicious Kṛttikā, worshipped by the gods: / come, neutral goddess, eldest daughter of Dakṣa, auspicious one!
I invoke Rohiṇī, granter of boons, beloved of the Moon: / come, Rohiṇī, knower of dharma, brilliant in fixed actions!
I invoke Ilvilā, granter of boons, beloved of the Moon: / come to me, goddess Ilvilā, brilliant in gentle actions!
I shall invoke Rudra, three-eyed, holding the trident in his hand: / come, Śaṅkara, self of all, sovereign of the great hosts of gaṇas!
I shall invoke Ārdrā, the asterism known as the Arm: / come, Ārdrā, lovely in all limbs, fierce, equal to Rudra!

3.21.s:
āvāhayiṣyāmi ditiṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣām ..
ādityāraṇi dharmajñe ehi devi mahāvrate .. 62 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi dharmajñaṃ tu punarvasum ..
punarvasau ihāgaccha carakarmaprasādhaka .. 63 ..
tiṣyamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ kṣiprasaṃjñitama ..
ehi puṣya mahābhāga poṣaṃ vardhaya sarvataḥ .. 64 ..
sarpānāvāhayiṣyāmi trailokyānantagocarān ..
āyāntu sarvataḥ sarpāḥ saumyarūpā bhavantu te .. 65 ..
āvāhayāmi cāśleṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ śrīvivardhinīm ..
āśleṣe tvamihābhyehi dāruṇe vijayaprade .. 66 ..
pitṝnāvāhayiṣyāmi martyamūrtidharānaham ..
āyāntu pitaraḥ śīghraṃ sudhākavyabhujo'vyayāḥ .. 67 ..
maghāmāvāhayiṣyāmi ugranakṣatramañjasā ..
ehi me subhage devi sarvāghaviniṣūdani .. 68 ..
bhagamāvāhayiṣyāmi bhaktasaubhāgyavardhanam..
ehi devavarācintya bhaktasaṃkaṭanāśaka .. 69 ..
3.21.d:
आवाहयिष्यामि दितिं तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषाम् ॥
आदित्यारणि धर्मज्ञे एहि देवि महाव्रते ॥ 62 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि धर्मज्ञं तु पुनर्वसुम् ॥
पुनर्वसौ इहागच्छ चरकर्मप्रसाधक ॥ 63 ॥
तिष्यमावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं क्षिप्रसंज्ञितम ॥
एहि पुष्य महाभाग पोषं वर्धय सर्वतः ॥ 64 ॥
सर्पानावाहयिष्यामि त्रैलोक्यानन्तगोचरान् ॥
आयान्तु सर्वतः सर्पाः सौम्यरूपा भवन्तु ते ॥ 65 ॥
आवाहयामि चाश्लेषां भक्तानां श्रीविवर्धिनीम् ॥
आश्लेषे त्वमिहाभ्येहि दारुणे विजयप्रदे ॥ 66 ॥
पितॄनावाहयिष्यामि मर्त्यमूर्तिधरानहम् ॥
आयान्तु पितरः शीघ्रं सुधाकव्यभुजोऽव्ययाः ॥ 67 ॥
मघामावाहयिष्यामि उग्रनक्षत्रमञ्जसा ॥
एहि मे सुभगे देवि सर्वाघविनिषूदनि ॥ 68 ॥
भगमावाहयिष्यामि भक्तसौभाग्यवर्धनम्॥
एहि देववराचिन्त्य भक्तसंकटनाशक ॥ 69 ॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke Diti, whose sins are burned away by ascetic heat: / kindler of the Ādityas, knower of dharma, come, goddess of great vows!
I shall invoke the asterism Punarvasu, knower of dharma: / come hither, Punarvasu, accomplisher of movable actions!
I shall invoke Tiṣya, the asterism known as swift: / come, Puṣya, highly fortunate one, increase nourishment everywhere!
I shall invoke the serpents whose range extends over the three worlds without end: / let the serpents come from every side; let them assume gentle forms!
I invoke Āśleṣā, who increases the prosperity of devotees: / come hither, Āśleṣā, fierce, granter of victory!
I shall invoke the ancestors, assuming mortal forms: / let the ancestors come swiftly, consuming nectar and ancestral food, imperishable!
I shall invoke Maghā, the fierce asterism, forthwith: / come to me, fortunate goddess, destroyer of all sins!
I shall invoke Bhaga, who increases the good fortune of devotees: / come, inconceivable best of gods, destroyer of distress for devotees!

3.21.s:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvaphalgunasaṃjñakam ..
ehi bhāgi mahābhāga ugrakarmaprasādhaka .. 3.104.70 ..
āvāhayiṣyāmyaryamṇamādityaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim ..
aryamaṃstvaṃ samabhyehi bhaktasaṅkaṭanāśana .. 71 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi uttarāphalgunīṃ śubhām ..
ehi tvaṃ subhage devi dhruve sarvāṅgasundari .. 72 ..
hastamāvāhayiṣyāmi sāvitraṃ kṣipramañjasā ..
ehi sāvitra dharmajña bhaktānāṃ pāpanāśaka .. 73 ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ tvaṣṭāramasitadyutim ..
ehi me bhagavaṃstvaṣṭaḥ prajāpālanatatpara .. 74 ..
citrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi citramūrtiṃ manoharām ..
ehi me varade devi mṛdukarmaprasādhike .. 75 ..
vāyumāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagaṃ dīptatejasam ..
deva vāyo tvamabhyehi sarvabhūtajagatpriya .. 76 ..
svātimāvāhayiṣyāmi nityamuttarasarvagām ..
devi svāti tvamabhyehi carakarmasu śobhane .. 77 ..
3.21.d:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वफल्गुनसंज्ञकम् ॥
एहि भागि महाभाग उग्रकर्मप्रसाधक ॥ 3.104.70 ॥
आवाहयिष्याम्यर्यम्णमादित्यं तेजसां निधिम् ॥
अर्यमंस्त्वं समभ्येहि भक्तसङ्कटनाशन ॥ 71 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि उत्तराफल्गुनीं शुभाम् ॥
एहि त्वं सुभगे देवि ध्रुवे सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि ॥ 72 ॥
हस्तमावाहयिष्यामि सावित्रं क्षिप्रमञ्जसा ॥
एहि सावित्र धर्मज्ञ भक्तानां पापनाशक ॥ 73 ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं त्वष्टारमसितद्युतिम् ॥
एहि मे भगवंस्त्वष्टः प्रजापालनतत्पर ॥ 74 ॥
चित्रामावाहयिष्यामि चित्रमूर्तिं मनोहराम् ॥
एहि मे वरदे देवि मृदुकर्मप्रसाधिके ॥ 75 ॥
वायुमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वगं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥
देव वायो त्वमभ्येहि सर्वभूतजगत्प्रिय ॥ 76 ॥
स्वातिमावाहयिष्यामि नित्यमुत्तरसर्वगाम् ॥
देवि स्वाति त्वमभ्येहि चरकर्मसु शोभने ॥ 77 ॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke the asterism named Pūrvaphalgunī: / come, Bhāgī, highly fortunate one, accomplisher of fierce actions!
I shall invoke Aryaman, the Āditya, treasure of splendours: / come forward, Aryaman, destroyer of distress for devotees!
I shall invoke the auspicious asterism Uttarāphalgunī: / come, fortunate goddess, fixed one, beautiful in all limbs!
I shall invoke Hasta, sacred to Savitṛ, swift, directly: / come, sacred to Savitṛ, knower of dharma, destroyer of sins of devotees!
I invoke the god Tvaṣṭṛ of dark lustre: / come to me, Lord Tvaṣṭṛ, intent upon protecting creatures!
I shall invoke Citrā of variegated form, enchanting: / come to me, boon-granting goddess, accomplisher of gentle actions!
I will invoke Vāyu, all-pervading and of blazing splendor. / O divine Vāyu, beloved of all beings and the world, come near.
I will invoke Svāti, always moving everywhere in the north. / O goddess Svāti, auspicious in mobile actions, come near.

3.21.s:
āvāhayiṣyāmīndrāgnī sahitau dīptatejasau ..
iṃdrātrehi jagannātha ehyagne vijayaprada .. 78 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi viśākhāmagratejasam ..
viśākhe tvamihābhyehi devi sādhāraṇe śubhe .. 79 ..
mitramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ dīptāṃśutejasam ..
ehi mitra mahābhāga bhaktānāmabhayaṃ kuru .. 3.104.80 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi tvanurādhāṃ varapradām ..
anurādhe tvamabhyehi mṛdukarmasu śobhane .. 81 ..
śakrosyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ jyeṣṭhāyāḥ śṛṇu pārthiva ..
jyeṣṭhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ śakradaivatam .. 82 ..
jyeṣṭhe devi tvamabhyehi dāruṇe cārulocane ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi nirṛtiṃ vīravanditam .. 83 ..
ehi deva virūpākṣa mahābala sadāśraya ..
mūlamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ dāruṇaṃ mahat .. 84 ..
ehi mūla mahābhāga bhaktānāmabhayaprada ..
āpastvāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagā varadāḥ śubhāḥ ..85..
3.21.d:
आवाहयिष्यामीन्द्राग्नी सहितौ दीप्ततेजसौ ॥
इंद्रात्रेहि जगन्नाथ एह्यग्ने विजयप्रद ॥ 78 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि विशाखामग्रतेजसम् ॥
विशाखे त्वमिहाभ्येहि देवि साधारणे शुभे ॥ 79 ॥
मित्रमावाहयिष्यामि देवं दीप्तांशुतेजसम् ॥
एहि मित्र महाभाग भक्तानामभयं कुरु ॥ 3.104.80 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि त्वनुराधां वरप्रदाम् ॥
अनुराधे त्वमभ्येहि मृदुकर्मसु शोभने ॥ 81 ॥
शक्रोस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं ज्येष्ठायाः शृणु पार्थिव ॥
ज्येष्ठामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं शक्रदैवतम् ॥ 82 ॥
ज्येष्ठे देवि त्वमभ्येहि दारुणे चारुलोचने ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि निरृतिं वीरवन्दितम् ॥ 83 ॥
एहि देव विरूपाक्ष महाबल सदाश्रय ॥
मूलमावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं दारुणं महत् ॥ 84 ॥
एहि मूल महाभाग भक्तानामभयप्रद ॥
आपस्त्वावाहयिष्यामि सर्वगा वरदाः शुभाः ॥85॥
3.21.m:
I will invoke Indra and Agni together, endowed with blazing splendor. / Come here, O Indra, lord of the world! Come, O Agni, grantor of victory!
I will invoke the asterism Viśākhā, endowed with foremost splendor. / Come here, O Viśākhā, auspicious goddess of intermediate nature.
I will invoke the god Mitra, endowed with the radiance of blazing rays. / Come, O fortunate Mitra; grant fearlessness to your devotees.
I will invoke the asterism Anurādhā, grantor of boons. / O Anurādhā, auspicious in gentle actions, come near.
The invocation of Śakra has been spoken; hear that of Jyeṣṭhā, O king. / I will invoke Jyeṣṭhā, the lunar mansion whose deity is Śakra.
O goddess Jyeṣṭhā, terrible yet fair-eyed, come near. / I will invoke the god Nirṛti, praised by heroes.
Come, O god Virūpākṣa, of great strength, constant refuge. / I will invoke Mūla, the great and terrible lunar mansion.
Come, O fortunate Mūla, granter of fearlessness to devotees. / I will invoke the Waters, all-pervading, boongiving, and auspicious.

3.21.s:
āpastvāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvāṣāḍheti saṃjñitam ..
ehi tvamugre varade pūrvāṣāḍhetisaṃjñite .. 86 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi yattadabhijiducyate ..
ehi dhiṣṇyavariṣṭhāya kṣiprakarmaprasādhaka .. 87 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi śravaṇaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
prasannastvaṃ samabhyehi carakarmaprasādhaka .. 88 ..
dhaniṣṭhe tvamihābhyehi carakarmaprasādhike .. 89 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi nāmnā śatabhiṣāṃ śubhām ..
āgaccha tvaṃ śatabhiṣe carakarmasu śobhane .. 3.104.90 ..
ajaikapādaṃ varadaṃ rudramāvāhayāmyaham ..
āgaccha rudra varada triśūlaparamāyudha .. 91 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvabhadrapadāmaham ..
ehi bhadrapade pūrve ugrakarmaprasādhani .. 92 ..
āhirbudhnyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ rudramāvāhayāmyaham ..
āhirbudhnya samabhyehi jaṭājūṭopaśobhita ..93..
3.21.d:
आपस्त्वावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वाषाढेति संज्ञितम् ॥
एहि त्वमुग्रे वरदे पूर्वाषाढेतिसंज्ञिते ॥ 86 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि यत्तदभिजिदुच्यते ॥
एहि धिष्ण्यवरिष्ठाय क्षिप्रकर्मप्रसाधक ॥ 87 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि श्रवणं सर्वकामदम् ॥
प्रसन्नस्त्वं समभ्येहि चरकर्मप्रसाधक ॥ 88 ॥
धनिष्ठे त्वमिहाभ्येहि चरकर्मप्रसाधिके ॥ 89 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि नाम्ना शतभिषां शुभाम् ॥
आगच्छ त्वं शतभिषे चरकर्मसु शोभने ॥ 3.104.90 ॥
अजैकपादं वरदं रुद्रमावाहयाम्यहम् ॥
आगच्छ रुद्र वरद त्रिशूलपरमायुध ॥ 91 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वभद्रपदामहम् ॥
एहि भद्रपदे पूर्वे उग्रकर्मप्रसाधनि ॥ 92 ॥
आहिर्बुध्न्यं महाभागं रुद्रमावाहयाम्यहम् ॥
आहिर्बुध्न्य समभ्येहि जटाजूटोपशोभित ॥93॥
3.21.m:
I will invoke the Waters, named Pūrvāṣāḍhā. / Come, O fierce one, giver of boons, designated as Pūrvāṣāḍhā.
I will invoke the asterism that is called Abhijit. / Come to the highest station, O accomplisher of swift deeds.
I will invoke the asterism Śravaṇa, which fulfills all desires. / Gracious, come near, O accomplisher of mobile actions.
Come here, O Dhaniṣṭhā, accomplisher of mobile actions.
I will invoke the auspicious asterism named Śatabhiṣaj. / Approach, O Śatabhiṣaj, auspicious in mobile actions.
I invoke Ajaikapād, the boon-giving Rudra. / Approach, O boon-giving Rudra, whose supreme weapon is the trident.
I will invoke the asterism Pūrvabhadrapadā. / Come, O Pūrvabhadrapadā, accomplisher of fierce actions.
I invoke Ahirbudhnya, the illustrious Rudra. / O Ahirbudhnya, adorned with matted hair, come near.

3.21.s:
dhruvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deśe bhadrapadottarām ..
ehi tvaṃ sumahābhāge mama bhadrapadottare .. 94 ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśakam ..
pūṣansamyagihābhyehi sarvakalmaṣanāśaka .. 95 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi revatīṃ bhīrudarśanām ..
ehi revati dharmajñe mṛdukarmaprasādhake .. 96 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi kṣipramaśvini saṃjñakam ..
ehyaśvini mahābhāge varade kāmadāyini .. 97 ..
yamamāvāhayiṣyāmi dharmarājamathācyutam ..
ehi dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha vaivasvata mahābhuja .. 98 ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi ugraṃ bharaṇisaṃjñakam ..
ehi tvaṃ devi bharaṇi subhage cārudarśane ..99..
prācīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sūryodayavibhūṣaṇāma ..
ehi tvaṃ varade pūrve śubhakarmaprasādhani .. 3.104.100 ..
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi varadāṃ pūrvadakṣiṇām ..
vahnipriye samabhyehi varade pūrvadakṣiṇe .. 101 ..
3.21.d:
ध्रुवमावाहयिष्यामि देशे भद्रपदोत्तराम् ॥
एहि त्वं सुमहाभागे मम भद्रपदोत्तरे ॥ 94 ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं पूषणं पापनाशकम् ॥
पूषन्सम्यगिहाभ्येहि सर्वकल्मषनाशक ॥ 95 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि रेवतीं भीरुदर्शनाम् ॥
एहि रेवति धर्मज्ञे मृदुकर्मप्रसाधके ॥ 96 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि क्षिप्रमश्विनि संज्ञकम् ॥
एह्यश्विनि महाभागे वरदे कामदायिनि ॥ 97 ॥
यममावाहयिष्यामि धर्मराजमथाच्युतम् ॥
एहि धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ वैवस्वत महाभुज ॥ 98 ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि उग्रं भरणिसंज्ञकम् ॥
एहि त्वं देवि भरणि सुभगे चारुदर्शने ॥99॥
प्राचीमावाहयिष्यामि सूर्योदयविभूषणाम ॥
एहि त्वं वरदे पूर्वे शुभकर्मप्रसाधनि ॥ 3.104.100 ॥
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि वरदां पूर्वदक्षिणाम् ॥
वह्निप्रिये समभ्येहि वरदे पूर्वदक्षिणे ॥ 101 ॥
3.21.m:
I will invoke fixed [and auspicious] Uttarābhādrapadā in its place. / Come, O most illustrious Uttarābhādrapadā of mine.
I invoke the god Pūṣan, destroyer of sins. / O Pūṣan, destroyer of all blemishes, come duly here.
I will invoke the asterism Revatī, of timid appearance. / Come, O Revatī, knower of dharma, accomplisher of gentle actions.
I will invoke the swift asterism named Aśvinī. / Come, O fortunate Aśvinī, grantor of boons, fulfiller of desires.
I will invoke Yama, the king of dharma, who never falls away. / Come, O best among upholders of dharma, son of Vivasvat, mighty-armed one.
I will invoke the fierce asterism named Bharaṇī. / Come, O goddess Bharaṇī, fortunate and lovely in appearance.
I will invoke the eastern direction, adorned by the rising of the sun. / Come, O boongiving east, accomplisher of auspicious actions.
I will invoke the boon-bestowing south-eastern direction. / Beloved of Agni, boongiver, come near, O south-east.

3.21.s:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ..
dakṣiṇe tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvakarmaśubhaprade .. 102 ..
3.21.d:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि दक्षिणां दक्षिणां दिशम् ॥
दक्षिणे त्वं समभ्येहि सर्वकर्मशुभप्रदे ॥ 102 ॥
3.21.m: I will invoke the southern direction, the generous one. / Come near, O south, grantor of auspiciousness in all rites.

3.21.s:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ dakṣiṇapaścimām ..
ehi tvaṃ nairṛte devi satataṃ bhūtivardhini .. 103 ..
3.21.d:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि शुभां दक्षिणपश्चिमाम् ॥
एहि त्वं नैरृते देवि सततं भूतिवर्धिनि ॥ 103 ॥
3.21.m: I will invoke the auspicious south-western direction. / Come, O goddess presiding over Nairṛta, ever increasing prosperity.

3.21.s:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi vāruṇīṃ varadāṃ sadā ..
āgaccha paścime devi varade varuṇapriye ..104..
3.21.d:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि वारुणीं वरदां सदा ॥
आगच्छ पश्चिमे देवि वरदे वरुणप्रिये ॥104॥
3.21.m: I will invoke the western direction, dedicated to Varuṇa, ever bestowing boons. / Approach, O goddess west, boongiver, beloved of Varuṇa.

3.21.s:
āvāhayiṣyāmi diśaṃ vāyavīṃ paścimottarām ..
varade tvaṃ samabhyehi vāyavye paścimottare .. 105 ..
3.21.d:
आवाहयिष्यामि दिशं वायवीं पश्चिमोत्तराम् ॥
वरदे त्वं समभ्येहि वायव्ये पश्चिमोत्तरे ॥ 105 ॥
3.21.m: I will invoke the north-western direction, belonging to Vāyu. / O boongiver, come near, O north-west presided over by Vāyu.

3.21.s:
āvāhayāmi dhanadaṃ devaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum ..
rājarāja samabhyehi sarvayajñeśvarādhipa .. 106 ..
3.21.d:
आवाहयामि धनदं देवं वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् ॥
राजराज समभ्येहि सर्वयज्ञेश्वराधिप ॥ 106 ॥
3.21.m: I invoke the god Dhanada, lord Vaiśravaṇa. / Come near, O king of kings, sovereign of all lords of sacrifice.

3.21.s:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi saumyāṃ dhanadapālitām ..
uttare tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvadharmaphalaprade .. 107 ..
3.21.d:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि सौम्यां धनदपालिताम् ॥
उत्तरे त्वं समभ्येहि सर्वधर्मफलप्रदे ॥ 107 ॥
3.21.m: I will invoke the northern direction, pleasing and protected by Dhanada. / Come near, O north, granter of the fruits of all dharmas.

3.21.s:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ prāguttarāmaham ..
ehi tvaṃ subhage devi satataṃ śivapālite .. 108 ..
3.21.d:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि शुभां प्रागुत्तरामहम् ॥
एहि त्वं सुभगे देवि सततं शिवपालिते ॥ 108 ॥
3.21.m: I will invoke the auspicious north-eastern direction. / Come, O fortunate goddess, ever guarded by Śiva.

3.21.s:
sarvānāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrṇakumbheṣu sāgarān ..
ratnādhyakṣāḥ samāyāntu catvāra iha sāgarāḥ .. 109 ..
3.21.d:
सर्वानावाहयिष्यामि पूर्णकुम्भेषु सागरान् ॥
रत्नाध्यक्षाः समायान्तु चत्वार इह सागराः ॥ 109 ॥
3.21.m: I will invoke all the oceans into the filled jars. / Let the four oceans, masters of jewels, arrive here.

3.21.s:
aiśānyāṃ diśi yaḥ kumbhaḥ pūrvastasyāṃ tu sāgaraḥ ..
āyātu śīghrameveha taraṅgormisamākula .. 3.104.110 ..
3.21.d:
ऐशान्यां दिशि यः कुम्भः पूर्वस्तस्यां तु सागरः ॥
आयातु शीघ्रमेवेह तरङ्गोर्मिसमाकुल ॥ 3.104.110 ॥
3.21.m: As for the jar in the north-eastern direction, the eastern ocean is in it. / Let it arrive quickly here, agitated with rolling waves.

3.21.s:
śīghramabhyehi nilaya yādasāṃ pūrvasāgara ..
taraṅgaśatasaṃkrāṃta bālabhāskaramaṇḍala .. 111 ..
3.21.d:
शीघ्रमभ्येहि निलय यादसां पूर्वसागर ॥
तरङ्गशतसंक्रांत बालभास्करमण्डल ॥ 111 ॥
3.21.m: Come quickly, O abode of aquatic monsters, eastern ocean, / crossed by hundreds of waves, reflecting the disc of the newly risen sun.

3.21.s:
āgneye ca samāyāta dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇaḥ śivaḥ ..
bahuratnaprabhāpuñjavimiśra salilāśaya .. 112 ..
3.21.d:
आग्नेये च समायात दक्षिणे दक्षिणः शिवः ॥
बहुरत्नप्रभापुञ्जविमिश्र सलिलाशय ॥ 112 ॥
3.21.m: And in the south-east has arrived the auspicious southern [ocean] in the south, / reservoir of waters mixed with the luster of many heaps of gems.

3.21.s:
yādasāṃ nilayābhyehi kṣipraṃ dakṣiṇasāgara ..
taraṅgadhauta pādāgra trikūṭaśikharācyuta .. 113 ..
3.21.d:
यादसां निलयाभ्येहि क्षिप्रं दक्षिणसागर ॥
तरङ्गधौत पादाग्र त्रिकूटशिखराच्युत ॥ 113 ॥
3.21.m: Come swiftly, O abode of aquatic creatures, southern ocean, / whose feet are washed by waves, never fallen from the peaks of Trikūṭa.

3.21.s:
paścimāyāḥ samāyātu kumbhe dakṣiṇapaścime ..
ratnapuñjamahājvālāvirājitamahodaka .. 114 ..
3.21.d:
पश्चिमायाः समायातु कुम्भे दक्षिणपश्चिमे ॥
रत्नपुञ्जमहाज्वालाविराजितमहोदक ॥ 114 ॥
3.21.m: Let [the ocean] of the west arrive in the pitcher in the south-west, / great body of water shining with blazing masses of gems.

3.21.s:
taraṅgamaṇḍitābhyehi kṣipraṃ paścimasāgara ..
astārkabimbasaṃkrāntagatamaṇḍaladurdṛśa .. 115 ..
3.21.d:
तरङ्गमण्डिताभ्येहि क्षिप्रं पश्चिमसागर ॥
अस्तार्कबिम्बसंक्रान्तगतमण्डलदुर्दृश ॥ 115 ॥
3.21.m: Come swiftly, O western ocean, adorned with waves, / hard to behold when the solar orb has set and entered [your] waters.

3.21.s:
uttaraśca tathābhyetu kumbhe vai paścimottare ..
himādriśikharacchāyākṣīrodasadṛśaḥ prabhuḥ .. 116 ..
3.21.d:
उत्तरश्च तथाभ्येतु कुम्भे वै पश्चिमोत्तरे ॥
हिमाद्रिशिखरच्छायाक्षीरोदसदृशः प्रभुः ॥ 116 ॥
3.21.m: And likewise let the northern ocean arrive into the north-western jar, / the lord resembling the Milk Ocean under the shadow of the snowy mountain's peaks.

3.21.s:
mahāpavitrasalila śīghramuttarasāgara ..
ihābhyehi mahābhāga yajamānābhivṛddhaye .. 117 ..
3.21.d:
महापवित्रसलिल शीघ्रमुत्तरसागर ॥
इहाभ्येहि महाभाग यजमानाभिवृद्धये ॥ 117 ॥
3.21.m: O northern ocean of exceedingly sacred water, / come here swiftly, O illustrious one, for the prosperity of the patron of the sacrifice.

3.21.s:
āvāhitānāṃ kartavyaṃ bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ ..
praṇāmamabhivādaṃ ca tato mantramudīrayet .. 118 ..
3.21.d:
आवाहितानां कर्तव्यं भूमौ कृत्वा ततः शिरः ॥
प्रणाममभिवादं च ततो मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 118 ॥
3.21.m: Placing his head on the ground before those who have been invoked, / he should offer prostration and greeting, and then utter the mantra:

3.21.s:
bhavatāṃ hi prasādena bhavatāṃ pratipūjane ..
prayatiṣye yathāśaktyā tanme'nujñātumarhatha .. 119 ..
3.21.d:
भवतां हि प्रसादेन भवतां प्रतिपूजने ॥
प्रयतिष्ये यथाशक्त्या तन्मेऽनुज्ञातुमर्हथ ॥ 119 ॥
3.21.m: "By your grace, in worshipping you, / I shall make effort according to my ability; therefore deign to grant me permission.

3.21.s:
yuṣmākaṃ pūjanaṃ kartuṃ kena śakyaṃ yathāvidhi ..
yuṣmatpūjāvihīnena kena labhyaṃ mahatphalam ..3.104.120..
3.21.d:
युष्माकं पूजनं कर्तुं केन शक्यं यथाविधि ॥
युष्मत्पूजाविहीनेन केन लभ्यं महत्फलम् ॥3.104.120॥
3.21.m: Who is capable of performing your worship according to proper rule? / Yet by whom can great fruit be obtained without worshipping you?

3.21.s:
tataḥ kartuṃ yathāśaktyā bhavatāṃ pratipūjanam ..
varadāḥ prayatiṣyāmi tanme'nujñātumarhatha ..121 ..
3.21.d:
ततः कर्तुं यथाशक्त्या भवतां प्रतिपूजनम् ॥
वरदाः प्रयतिष्यामि तन्मेऽनुज्ञातुमर्हथ ॥121 ॥
3.21.m: Therefore I shall endeavor, according to my ability, to perform worship toward you, / O givers of boons; deign to grant me permission."

3.21.s:
svāṃsvāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya dikpālā dīptatejasaḥ ..
utsādayantu sakalānvighnānyānsamupasthitāna .. 125 ..
3.21.d:
स्वांस्वां दिशमधिष्ठाय दिक्पाला दीप्ततेजसः ॥
उत्सादयन्तु सकलान्विघ्नान्यान्समुपस्थितान ॥ 125 ॥
3.21.m: Presiding over their respective directions, may the guardians of the directions, of blazing splendor, / eradicate all obstacles that have presented themselves.

3.21.s:
vināyakā vighnakarāḥ samogrā yajñadviṣo ye piśitāśanāśca ..
siddhārthakairvajrasamānakalpairmayā nirastā vidiśaḥ prayāntu .. 123 ..
3.105
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
lokānāvāhayiṣyāmi haṃsarūpānmanoharān..
āyāntu vāhanatvena ye sthitāḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ..1..
vṛṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi catuṣpādaṃ kakudminam ..
vṛṣābhyehi mahābhāga dharmamūrte varaprada..2..
śūlamāvāhayiṣyāmi guṇādhāraṃ mahādyutim..
ehi śūla mahābhāga daityanāthagaṇāntaka .. 3 ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ nandīśvaraṃ prabhum ..
abhyehi nandinbhagavan sarvalokanamaskṛta .. 4 ..
āvāhayāmi varadaṃ vīrabhadraṃ mahābalam ..
abhyehi vīrabhadrāya mahāgaṇagaṇeśvara .. 5 ..
jvaramāvāhayiṣyāmi tripādaṃ tribhujaṃ prabhum ..
jvarābhyehi mahābhāga satataṃ caraṇojjvala .. 6 ..
3.21.d:
विनायका विघ्नकराः समोग्रा यज्ञद्विषो ये पिशिताशनाश्च ॥
सिद्धार्थकैर्वज्रसमानकल्पैर्मया निरस्ता विदिशः प्रयान्तु ॥ 123 ॥
3.105
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
लोकानावाहयिष्यामि हंसरूपान्मनोहरान्॥
आयान्तु वाहनत्वेन ये स्थिताः परमेष्ठिनः ॥1॥
वृषमावाहयिष्यामि चतुष्पादं ककुद्मिनम् ॥
वृषाभ्येहि महाभाग धर्ममूर्ते वरप्रद॥2॥
शूलमावाहयिष्यामि गुणाधारं महाद्युतिम्॥
एहि शूल महाभाग दैत्यनाथगणान्तक ॥ 3 ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि देवं नन्दीश्वरं प्रभुम् ॥
अभ्येहि नन्दिन्भगवन् सर्वलोकनमस्कृत ॥ 4 ॥
आवाहयामि वरदं वीरभद्रं महाबलम् ॥
अभ्येहि वीरभद्राय महागणगणेश्वर ॥ 5 ॥
ज्वरमावाहयिष्यामि त्रिपादं त्रिभुजं प्रभुम् ॥
ज्वराभ्येहि महाभाग सततं चरणोज्ज्वल ॥ 6 ॥
3.21.m:
May the obstacle-makers, Vināyakas, fierce enemies of the sacrifice, and flesh-eaters, / driven away by me with white mustard seeds equal to thunderbolts, flee to the intermediate directions.
3.105
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I shall invoke the charming worlds in the form of swans; / may those who stand as vehicles of Parameṣṭhin arrive.
I shall invoke the four-footed, humped bull: / Come, O bull, highly fortunate one, embodiment of dharma, granter of boons!
I shall invoke the trident, the abode of virtues, endowed with great splendour: / Come, O trident, highly fortunate one, destroyer of the hosts of Daitya chiefs!
I shall invoke the divine lord Nandīśvara: / Come, O blessed Nandin, reverenced by all the worlds!
I invoke the boon-giving, mighty Vīrabhadra: / Come, O Vīrabhadra, lord over the great host of gaṇas!
I shall invoke Fever, the three-footed, three-armed lord: / Come, O Fever, highly fortunate one, constantly radiant on your feet!

3.21.s:
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi bhadrakālīṃ sukhapradām ..
āgaccha varade durge sarvalokanamaskṛte .. 7 ..
āvāhayāmi paulomīṃ varadāṃ nityanandinīma ..
śakrapatni tvamabhyehi varade kāmarūpiṇi .. 8 ..
nāgamāvāhayipyāmi tathairāvaṇasaṃjñitam ..
ihābhyehi mahābhāga śakranāga jayāvaha .. 9 ..
vajramāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvabhedakamāśugam ..
śīghraṃ vajra tvamabhyehi sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇa .. 3.105.10..
hayānāvāhayiṣyāmi chandorū pānmanoharān ..
āgacchantu mamādyeha turagā vyomagocarāḥ .. 11 ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi daṇḍasaṃjñaṃ balotkaṭam ..
daṇḍa śīghramihābhyehi mahābalaparākrama ..12..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi piṅgalaṃ sumahābalam ..
lokasākṣistvamabhyehi piṅgalāya mahābala ..13 ..
dhvajamāvāhayiṣyāmi citraṃ sūryasamaprabham ..
dharma śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi sūryadhvajagatācyuta .. 14 ..
3.21.d:
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि भद्रकालीं सुखप्रदाम् ॥
आगच्छ वरदे दुर्गे सर्वलोकनमस्कृते ॥ 7 ॥
आवाहयामि पौलोमीं वरदां नित्यनन्दिनीम ॥
शक्रपत्नि त्वमभ्येहि वरदे कामरूपिणि ॥ 8 ॥
नागमावाहयिप्यामि तथैरावणसंज्ञितम् ॥
इहाभ्येहि महाभाग शक्रनाग जयावह ॥ 9 ॥
वज्रमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वभेदकमाशुगम् ॥
शीघ्रं वज्र त्वमभ्येहि सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हण ॥ 3.105.10॥
हयानावाहयिष्यामि छन्दोरू पान्मनोहरान् ॥
आगच्छन्तु ममाद्येह तुरगा व्योमगोचराः ॥ 11 ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि दण्डसंज्ञं बलोत्कटम् ॥
दण्ड शीघ्रमिहाभ्येहि महाबलपराक्रम ॥12॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि पिङ्गलं सुमहाबलम् ॥
लोकसाक्षिस्त्वमभ्येहि पिङ्गलाय महाबल ॥13 ॥
ध्वजमावाहयिष्यामि चित्रं सूर्यसमप्रभम् ॥
धर्म शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि सूर्यध्वजगताच्युत ॥ 14 ॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke the goddess Bhadrakālī, the bestower of happiness: / Come, O boon-giving Durgā, reverenced by all the worlds!
I invoke Paulomī, the boon-giver who continuously delights: / Come, O wife of Śakra, boon-giver who assume any form at will!
I shall likewise invoke the elephant known as Airāvaṇa: / Come here, O highly fortunate one, elephant of Śakra, bringer of victory!
I shall invoke the swift thunderbolt that pierces all: / Come quickly, O thunderbolt, destroyer of all wicked ones!
I shall invoke the charming horses who embody the Vedic meters: / May the coursers moving through the sky come here to me today!
I shall invoke the one named Daṇḍa, towering with strength: / O Daṇḍa, come here quickly, of mighty strength and valour!
I shall invoke Piṅgala, who is of very great power: / Come, O witness of the worlds, O mighty Piṅgala!
I shall invoke the splendid banner, bright as the sun: / Come quickly, O Dharma, steadfast one placed upon the sun's banner!

3.21.s:
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sūryabhāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm ..
devi tvaṃ tūrṇamāgaccha sarvalokanamaskṛte ... .. 15 ..
rājñīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sūryapatnīṃ surūpiṇīm..
āgaccha varade rājñi jagaddhāriṇi pūjite ..16..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi sūryapatnīṃ suvarcasām..
dhyāye devi tvamāgaccha kṛtākṛtavicāriṇi ..17..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi daśacandramaso hayān ..
sarve śīghramihāyāntu candrāśvāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ.....
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi kāntiṃ tridaśavallabhām ..
kānte śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi śaśāṅkadayite śubhe ..19..
śobhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi kāṅkṣitāṃ bhuvaneśvarīm ..
śobhe śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi sarvalokaikasundari.. 3.105.20 ..
dinamāvāhayiṣyāmi samastadhvāntanāśakam ..
dina śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi darśitākhilamaṇḍala .. ..
rātrimāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvabhūtasukhāvahām ..
rātri devi tvamabhyehi sarvabhūtavaraprade .22..
3.21.d:
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि सूर्यभां कामरूपिणीम् ॥
देवि त्वं तूर्णमागच्छ सर्वलोकनमस्कृते ॥॥। 15 ॥
राज्ञीमावाहयिष्यामि सूर्यपत्नीं सुरूपिणीम्॥
आगच्छ वरदे राज्ञि जगद्धारिणि पूजिते ॥16॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि सूर्यपत्नीं सुवर्चसाम्॥
ध्याये देवि त्वमागच्छ कृताकृतविचारिणि ॥17॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि दशचन्द्रमसो हयान् ॥
सर्वे शीघ्रमिहायान्तु चन्द्राश्वाः कामरूपिणः॥॥।
अहमावाहयिष्यामि कान्तिं त्रिदशवल्लभाम् ॥
कान्ते शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि शशाङ्कदयिते शुभे ॥19॥
शोभामावाहयिष्यामि काङ्क्षितां भुवनेश्वरीम् ॥
शोभे शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि सर्वलोकैकसुन्दरि॥ 3.105.20 ॥
दिनमावाहयिष्यामि समस्तध्वान्तनाशकम् ॥
दिन शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि दर्शिताखिलमण्डल ॥ ॥
रात्रिमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वभूतसुखावहाम् ॥
रात्रि देवि त्वमभ्येहि सर्वभूतवरप्रदे .22॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke the goddess endowed with solar radiance, who takes forms at will: / O goddess, reverenced by all the worlds, come swiftly!
I shall invoke Rājñī, the lovely wife of the sun: / Come, O boon-giving Rājñī, supporter of the universe, worthy of worship!
I shall invoke the radiant wife of the sun: / Come, O goddess Dhyāyī, who discerns what is done and left undone!
I shall invoke the ten horses of the Moon; / may all the horses of the Moon, taking forms at will, come here quickly! / I shall invoke Kānti, beloved of the gods: / Come quickly, O auspicious Kānti, beloved of the Moon!
I shall invoke Śobhā, the cherished ruler of the world: / Come quickly, O Śobhā, the sole beauty of all the worlds!
I shall invoke Day, the destroyer of all darkness: / Come quickly, O Day, you who reveal the entire realm! / I shall invoke Night, the bringer of comfort to all beings: / Come, O goddess Night, granter of boons to all beings!

3.21.s:
sandhyāmāvāhayiṣyāmi devīṃ brāhmaṇapūjitām ..
āgaccha varade sandhye sarvabhūtanamaskṛte .. 23 ..
svāhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi vahnerbhāgaṃ vibhāvarīm ..
svāhebhyehi mahābhāge varade kāmarūpiṇi .. 24..
vedānāvāhayiṣyāmi śubharūpadharānaham ..
āyāntu vāhanatvena dhūmraketuvyavasthitāḥ .. 25 ..
āvāhayiṣye mahiṣaṃ mahābalaparākramam ..
āgaccheha mahābhāga sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇa .. 26 ..
daṇḍamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvavāhanapūjitam ..
ehi daṇḍa mahābhāga sarvasattvavināśana .. 27 ..
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi dhūmrorṇāṃ cārulocanām ..
āgaccha devi dhūmrorṇe sarvalokanamaskṛte .. 28 ..
kālamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvatrāhatapūjitam ..
kālābhyehi mahābhāga sarvasattvabhayaṅkara .. 29 ..
mṛtyumāvāhayiṣyāmi devīṃ sarvaharāmaham ..
devi mṛtyo tvamabhyehi sarvage kāmarūpiṇi .. 3.105.30 ..
3.21.d:
सन्ध्यामावाहयिष्यामि देवीं ब्राह्मणपूजिताम् ॥
आगच्छ वरदे सन्ध्ये सर्वभूतनमस्कृते ॥ 23 ॥
स्वाहामावाहयिष्यामि वह्नेर्भागं विभावरीम् ॥
स्वाहेभ्येहि महाभागे वरदे कामरूपिणि ॥ 24॥
वेदानावाहयिष्यामि शुभरूपधरानहम् ॥
आयान्तु वाहनत्वेन धूम्रकेतुव्यवस्थिताः ॥ 25 ॥
आवाहयिष्ये महिषं महाबलपराक्रमम् ॥
आगच्छेह महाभाग सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हण ॥ 26 ॥
दण्डमावाहयिष्यामि सर्ववाहनपूजितम् ॥
एहि दण्ड महाभाग सर्वसत्त्वविनाशन ॥ 27 ॥
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि धूम्रोर्णां चारुलोचनाम् ॥
आगच्छ देवि धूम्रोर्णे सर्वलोकनमस्कृते ॥ 28 ॥
कालमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वत्राहतपूजितम् ॥
कालाभ्येहि महाभाग सर्वसत्त्वभयङ्कर ॥ 29 ॥
मृत्युमावाहयिष्यामि देवीं सर्वहरामहम् ॥
देवि मृत्यो त्वमभ्येहि सर्वगे कामरूपिणि ॥ 3.105.30 ॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke Twilight, the goddess worshipped by brahmins: / Come, O boon-giving Twilight, reverenced by all beings!
I shall invoke Svāhā, the shining portion of Fire: / Come, O highly fortunate Svāhā, boon-giver who assume any form at will!
I shall invoke the Vedas, who bear auspicious forms: / May they arrive as the mount, situated on the smoke-bannered [Fire]!
I shall invoke the buffalo of great strength and valour: / Come here, O highly fortunate one, destroyer of all wicked ones!
I shall invoke the Staff, worshipped among all mounts: / Come, O highly fortunate Staff, destroyer of all living beings!
I shall invoke the goddess Dhūmrorṇā of lovely eyes: / Come, O goddess Dhūmrorṇā, reverenced by all the worlds!
I shall invoke Time, worshipped as unthwarted everywhere: / Come, O highly fortunate Time, inspirer of dread in all beings!
I shall invoke the goddess Death, who takes away all: / Come, O goddess Death, all-pervading one who assume any form at will!

3.21.s:
āvāhayāmi varadaṃ citraguptaṃ sukhapradam ..
citragupta samabhyehi sarvatrasamadarśana .. 31 ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi virūpākṣaṃ mahābalam ..
virūpākṣa samabhyehi niśācaragaṇeśvara .. 32 ..
uṣṭramāvāhayiṣyāmi mahāmohamiti śrutam ..
uṣṭrābhyehi mahābhāga mahāgrīva mahāgate .. 33 ..
gaurīmāvāhayiṣyāmi jalādhipatisundarīm ..
ehi gauri mahādevi varade kāmarūpiṇi ..34..
haṃsānāvāhayiṣyāmi samudreṇa supūjitān..
āyāntu varadā haṃsā rasācārā vihaṅgamāḥ .. 35 ..
pāśamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvākarṣaṇatatparam ..
pāśābhyehi mahābhāga sarvasattvavaśaṅkara .. 36 ..
gaṅgāmāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm ..
gaṅge śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi pīyūṣasadṛśodake .. 37 ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi yamunāṃ ca yamānujām ..
āgaccha yamune devi sarvakalmaṣanāśini .. 38 ..
3.21.d:
आवाहयामि वरदं चित्रगुप्तं सुखप्रदम् ॥
चित्रगुप्त समभ्येहि सर्वत्रसमदर्शन ॥ 31 ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि विरूपाक्षं महाबलम् ॥
विरूपाक्ष समभ्येहि निशाचरगणेश्वर ॥ 32 ॥
उष्ट्रमावाहयिष्यामि महामोहमिति श्रुतम् ॥
उष्ट्राभ्येहि महाभाग महाग्रीव महागते ॥ 33 ॥
गौरीमावाहयिष्यामि जलाधिपतिसुन्दरीम् ॥
एहि गौरि महादेवि वरदे कामरूपिणि ॥34॥
हंसानावाहयिष्यामि समुद्रेण सुपूजितान्॥
आयान्तु वरदा हंसा रसाचारा विहङ्गमाः ॥ 35 ॥
पाशमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वाकर्षणतत्परम् ॥
पाशाभ्येहि महाभाग सर्वसत्त्ववशङ्कर ॥ 36 ॥
गङ्गामावाहयिष्यामि सर्वकल्मषनाशिनीम् ॥
गङ्गे शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि पीयूषसदृशोदके ॥ 37 ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि यमुनां च यमानुजाम् ॥
आगच्छ यमुने देवि सर्वकल्मषनाशिनि ॥ 38 ॥
3.21.m:
I invoke the boon-giving Citragupta, who brings happiness: / Come, O Citragupta, who view all things equally everywhere!
I shall invoke the mighty Virūpākṣa: / Come, O Virūpākṣa, lord over the hosts of night-wanderers!
I shall invoke the camel known as Great Delusion: / Come, O highly fortunate camel, of long neck and great stride!
I shall invoke Gaurī, the beautiful wife of the lord of the waters: / Come, O Gaurī, great goddess, boon-giver who assume any form at will!
I shall invoke the swans well worshipped by the ocean: / May the boon-giving swans, birds dwelling on the waters, arrive!
I shall invoke the noose, intent on drawing in all: / Come, O highly fortunate noose, who subjugate all beings!
I shall invoke the Gaṅgā, destroyer of all sins: / Come quickly, O Gaṅgā, whose water is like nectar!
I shall invoke Yamunā, the younger sister of Yama: / Come, O goddess Yamunā, destroyer of all sins!

3.21.s:
śivāmāvāhayiṣyāmi vāyoḥ patnīṃ prabhāvatīm ..
śivebhyehi mahābhāge varade kāmarūpiṇi .. 39 ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi śibikāṃ paramāyatām ..
śibike tvamihābhyehi sarvasattvasukhaṅkari .. 3.105.40 ..
naramāvāhayiṣyāmi narādhipativāhanam ..
nara śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi tathā nṛpatināyaka .. 41 ..
śaṅkhamāvāhayiṣyāmi nidhipravaramuttamam ..
śīghraṃ śaṅkha tvamabhyehi dhanādhipativallabha.. 42 ..
padmamāvāhayiṣyāmi nidhipravaramuttamam ..
padma śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi mahāvibhavakāraka .. 43 ..
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi pārvatīṃ haravallabhām ..
devi śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi mahāvibhavakārike .. 44 ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi jayantaṃ śakranandanam ..
jayanta śīghramabhyehi sarvāsuravimardana .. 45 ..
āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ puṣkaraṃ kāmagaṃ śubham ..
puṣkara tvamihābhyehi sarvajñānaprakāśaka..46..
3.21.d:
शिवामावाहयिष्यामि वायोः पत्नीं प्रभावतीम् ॥
शिवेभ्येहि महाभागे वरदे कामरूपिणि ॥ 39 ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि शिबिकां परमायताम् ॥
शिबिके त्वमिहाभ्येहि सर्वसत्त्वसुखङ्करि ॥ 3.105.40 ॥
नरमावाहयिष्यामि नराधिपतिवाहनम् ॥
नर शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि तथा नृपतिनायक ॥ 41 ॥
शङ्खमावाहयिष्यामि निधिप्रवरमुत्तमम् ॥
शीघ्रं शङ्ख त्वमभ्येहि धनाधिपतिवल्लभ॥ 42 ॥
पद्ममावाहयिष्यामि निधिप्रवरमुत्तमम् ॥
पद्म शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि महाविभवकारक ॥ 43 ॥
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि पार्वतीं हरवल्लभाम् ॥
देवि शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि महाविभवकारिके ॥ 44 ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि जयन्तं शक्रनन्दनम् ॥
जयन्त शीघ्रमभ्येहि सर्वासुरविमर्दन ॥ 45 ॥
आवाहयिष्ये वरदं पुष्करं कामगं शुभम् ॥
पुष्कर त्वमिहाभ्येहि सर्वज्ञानप्रकाशक॥46॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke Śivā, the radiant wife of the Wind: / Come, O highly fortunate Śivā, boon-giver who assume any form at will!
I shall invoke the very spacious palanquin: / Come here, O palanquin, who bring comfort to all beings!
I shall invoke the man, the mount of the lord of men: / Come quickly, O man, and likewise leader of sovereigns!
I shall invoke Śaṅkha, the supreme and best of treasures: / Come quickly, O Śaṅkha, beloved of the lord of wealth!
I shall invoke Padma, the supreme and best of treasures: / Come quickly, O Padma, source of great abundance!
I shall invoke the goddess Pārvatī, beloved of Hara: / Come quickly, O goddess, producer of great magnificence!
I shall invoke Jayanta, the son of Śakra: / Come quickly, O Jayanta, crusher of all Asuras!
I shall invoke the boon-granting Puṣkara, who moves at will and is auspicious:
O Puṣkara, come here, you who reveal all knowledge.

3.21.s:
jyotsnāmāvāhaviṣyāmi trailokyasyaikasundari ..
āgaccha varade jyotsne sarvabhūtasukhaṅkari ..47..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi tvāmeva nalakūbaram ..
samabhyehi mahābhāga dhanadasyātmasambhava .. 48..
āvāhayiṣyāmi tathā raviputraṃ yamāgrajam ..
sūryaputra samabhyehi bhaktakalyāṇakāraka ..49..
dharmamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvalokasukhāvaham ..
dharmābhyehi mahābhāga jagatāṃ paripālaka ..3.105.50..
arthamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvalokasukhāvaham ..
arthabhyehi mahābhāga sarvabādhāvināśaka..51..
kāmamāvāhayiṣyāmi phalaṃ sarvasya kāraṇa ..
kāma śīghraṃ tvama bhyehi sarvaprāṇihṛdi sthita..52..
rātrimāvāhayiṣyāmi devīṃ sarvajagatpriyām ..
abhyehi varade devi rati tvamaparājite..53 ..
nidrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvalokasukhapradām ..
āgaccha varade nidre trailokyaparimohini..54..
3.21.d:
ज्योत्स्नामावाहविष्यामि त्रैलोक्यस्यैकसुन्दरि ॥
आगच्छ वरदे ज्योत्स्ने सर्वभूतसुखङ्करि ॥47॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि त्वामेव नलकूबरम् ॥
समभ्येहि महाभाग धनदस्यात्मसम्भव ॥ 48॥
आवाहयिष्यामि तथा रविपुत्रं यमाग्रजम् ॥
सूर्यपुत्र समभ्येहि भक्तकल्याणकारक ॥49॥
धर्ममावाहयिष्यामि सर्वलोकसुखावहम् ॥
धर्माभ्येहि महाभाग जगतां परिपालक ॥3.105.50॥
अर्थमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वलोकसुखावहम् ॥
अर्थभ्येहि महाभाग सर्वबाधाविनाशक॥51॥
काममावाहयिष्यामि फलं सर्वस्य कारण ॥
काम शीघ्रं त्वम भ्येहि सर्वप्राणिहृदि स्थित॥52॥
रात्रिमावाहयिष्यामि देवीं सर्वजगत्प्रियाम् ॥
अभ्येहि वरदे देवि रति त्वमपराजिते॥53 ॥
निद्रामावाहयिष्यामि सर्वलोकसुखप्रदाम् ॥
आगच्छ वरदे निद्रे त्रैलोक्यपरिमोहिनि॥54॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke Moonlight, the sole beauty of the three worlds:
Come, boon-granting Moonlight, bringer of joy to all beings.
I shall invoke you yourself, Nalakūbara:
Come here, most fortunate one, son of the Giver of Wealth.
I shall likewise invoke the son of the Sun, elder brother of Yama:
Come here, son of the Sun, author of welfare for your devotees.
I shall invoke Dharma, bringer of joy to all the worlds:
Come here, O Dharma, most fortunate one, protector of the worlds.
I shall invoke Artha, bringer of joy to all the worlds:
Come here, O Artha, most fortunate one, destroyer of all afflictions.
I shall invoke Kāma, the fruit and cause of everything:
O Kāma, come quickly, you who dwell in the heart of every living being.
I shall invoke Night, the goddess dear to all the world:
Come here, boon-granting goddess, O Night, you who are unconquered.
I shall invoke Sleep, who bestows joy upon all the worlds:
Come, boon-granting Sleep, you who enchant the three worlds.

3.21.s:
āvāhayiṣye varadāṃ mahādevīṃ sarasvatīm..
śīghraṃ devi tvamabhyehi sarvakāmavaraprade .. 55 ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi tathā dhanvatariṃ prabhum ..
dhanvantare tvamabhyehi kṣīrodārṇavasambhava ..56..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi uccaiḥśravasamaśvapam ..
hayarāja samabhyehi kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhava .. 57..
yeṣāmāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ teṣāṃ mantramidaṃ paṭhet ..
aśvinau praṇataḥ staumi darbhapāṇiratandritaḥ .. 58 ..
āvāhanānāṃ ca gaṇaṃ tathoktaṃ mahāśubhaṃ pāpaharaṃ pavitram ..
āvāhitāḥ sannihitāstvavaśyaṃ devā bhavantyuttamavaṃśajātāḥ .. 59 ..
3.21.d:
आवाहयिष्ये वरदां महादेवीं सरस्वतीम्॥
शीघ्रं देवि त्वमभ्येहि सर्वकामवरप्रदे ॥ 55 ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि तथा धन्वतरिं प्रभुम् ॥
धन्वन्तरे त्वमभ्येहि क्षीरोदार्णवसम्भव ॥56॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वपम् ॥
हयराज समभ्येहि क्षीरोदार्णवसंभव ॥ 57॥
येषामावाहनं प्रोक्तं तेषां मन्त्रमिदं पठेत् ॥
अश्विनौ प्रणतः स्तौमि दर्भपाणिरतन्द्रितः ॥ 58 ॥
आवाहनानां च गणं तथोक्तं महाशुभं पापहरं पवित्रम् ॥
आवाहिताः सन्निहितास्त्ववश्यं देवा भवन्त्युत्तमवंशजाताः ॥ 59 ॥
3.21.m:
I shall invoke the boon-granting great goddess Sarasvatī:
Come quickly, O goddess, granter of the boons of all desires.
I shall likewise invoke the lord Dhanvantari:
O Dhanvantari, come here, you who arose from the Ocean of Milk.
I shall invoke Uccaiḥśravas, the guardian of horses:
Come here, king of horses, you who arose from the Ocean of Milk.
For those whose invocation has been stated, one should recite this mantra:
Bowing low with kuśa grass in hand, unflagging, I praise the two Aśvins.
Thus the group of invocations has been proclaimed, most auspicious, purifying, and removing sins;
when invoked, the gods born of noble lineage inevitably become present.
